data.body: **[P2] Preserve linkage-error isolation in the propagation hook.** Existing `runHook` isolates `LinkageError`, but this collector catches only `Exception`. A plugin with an incompatible dependency can throw `NoSuchMethodError` or `NoClassDefFoundError` here, skipping subsequent plugins and aborting the invoke before its START checkpoint. An optional instrumentation failure can therefore fail the workflow. Catch `LinkageError` too, preserve propagation of other `Error` types, and update `InvokePropagationErrorTest` to verify that linkage failures allow collection and checkpointing to continue.
